077dd8ec4f944b20361a6740d2edd0aa55ec4b2b.text:
; Offline candidate only, not host policy or an admitted launcher.
; Explicit exec context u:r:init:s0, preserving original Android identity downstream.
(type archtv_launcher)
(role archtv_launcher_r)
(userrole linux.system_u archtv_launcher_r)
(roletype archtv_launcher_r archtv_launcher)
(typeattributeset linux.domain (archtv_launcher))
; Original Linux process constraints otherwise forbid the cross-user/role edge.
; This exception grants no AV permission; only this new actor gets it.
(typeattributeset linux.process_uncond_exempt (archtv_launcher))
(roleallow archtv_launcher_r r)
(allow archtv_launcher self (process (setexec)))
(allow archtv_launcher init_exec (file (getattr open read execute)))
(allow archtv_launcher init (process (transition siginh rlimitinh)))
; The original coordinator inherits the host lifetime channel, not arbitrary host IPC.
(allow init archtv_launcher (fd (use)))
(allow init archtv_launcher (unix_stream_socket (read write getattr getopt setopt shutdown)))
; Genuine original libselinux status/access/create/context interfaces on Linux labels.
(allow init linux.security_t (dir (getattr search)))
(allow init linux.security_t (file (read getattr map open write)))
(allow init linux.security_t (security (compute_av compute_create check_context)))
; New cross-boundary assertions remain enabled alongside all original assertions.
(typeattribute archtv_not_init)
(typeattributeset archtv_not_init (not init))
(neverallow archtv_launcher archtv_not_init (process (transition)))
(typeattribute archtv_all_types)
(typeattributeset archtv_all_types (all))
(neverallow archtv_launcher archtv_all_types (process (dyntransition)))
(neverallow archtv_launcher init_exec (file (write append relabelto relabelfrom)))
(neverallow init linux.security_t (security (load_policy setenforce setbool setsecparam setcheckreqprot)))
(neverallow appdomain linux.security_t (file (write)))

; Offline bootstrap model: Linux-owned userspace initial-SID subject only.
; Intended entry file is a verified root-owned 0700 Rust supervisor image.
; No host file is labelled or installed by this module.
(type archtv_launcher_exec)
(roletype linux.object_r archtv_launcher_exec)
(typetransition linux.init_t archtv_launcher_exec process archtv_launcher)
(roletransition linux.system_r archtv_launcher_exec process archtv_launcher_r)
(roleallow linux.system_r archtv_launcher_r)
(allow linux.init_t archtv_launcher (process (transition siginh rlimitinh)))
(allow linux.init_t archtv_launcher_exec (file (read getattr map open execute)))
(allow archtv_launcher archtv_launcher_exec (file (read getattr map open execute entrypoint)))
; Linux labels own the backing xattr filesystem. Actual label/install path unproved.
(allow archtv_launcher_exec linux.fs_t (filesystem (associate)))
; Bound producers independently of generic Linux role membership.
(typeattribute archtv_not_bootstrap_creator)
(typeattributeset archtv_not_bootstrap_creator (not linux.init_t))
(neverallow archtv_not_bootstrap_creator archtv_launcher (process (transition dyntransition)))
(typeattribute archtv_bootstrap_accessors)
(typeattributeset archtv_bootstrap_accessors (linux.init_t archtv_launcher))
(typeattribute archtv_not_bootstrap_accessor)
(typeattributeset archtv_not_bootstrap_accessor (not archtv_bootstrap_accessors))
(neverallow archtv_not_bootstrap_accessor archtv_launcher_exec (file (execute execute_no_trans)))
(neverallow archtv_not_bootstrap_creator archtv_launcher_exec (file (write append create relabelto relabelfrom)))

; Preserve NNP/nosuid flags using the original targeted process2 mechanism.
; This affects SELinux label transitions, not Unix setuid/file capability semantics.
(allow linux.init_t archtv_launcher (process2 (nnp_transition nosuid_transition)))
(allow archtv_launcher init (process2 (nnp_transition nosuid_transition)))
(neverallow archtv_not_bootstrap_creator archtv_launcher (process2 (nnp_transition nosuid_transition)))
(neverallow archtv_launcher archtv_not_init (process2 (nnp_transition nosuid_transition)))

; Existing NativeProcess::Drop uses Child::kill for failed startup/timeout.
; Only the original coordinator, not other services/host domains, is admitted.
(allow archtv_launcher init (process (sigkill)))
(neverallow archtv_launcher archtv_not_init (process (sigkill)))

; Creator SID may be shared by surviving pre-policy userspace tasks.
; It must not mint or mutate the trusted entry label on writable files.
; A verified prelabelled immutable bundle/installer trust chain is still required.
(neverallow archtv_all_types archtv_launcher_exec (file (create write append setattr relabelto relabelfrom)))
